Switch on one permission for LX and %1$s opens in this window. LX does the rest by itself, then switches that permission off again.
Used once, to connect LX Bridge: LX goes through Developer options and Wireless debugging in Settings by itself, then switches this off. It sees no other app.

LX Bridge lets apps open in LX windows with no other app. Tap Connect automatically and switch on LX Bridge on Android\'s accessibility page. LX then turns on Developer options and Wireless debugging by itself and switches that permission off again. If the phone has a screen lock, Android may ask for your PIN once. After each restart LX needs Wi-Fi for a few seconds.
LX could not finish connecting by itself on this phone. Use Connect with a code.

LX Bridge starts by itself as soon as Wi-Fi connects. The network does not need internet.
USB debugging is off, so Wireless debugging stays on while LX Bridge runs. Apps in LX windows close if Wi-Fi drops. Turn on USB debugging in Developer options to keep them open.

With LX, each app runs on a display of its own inside an LX window, with LX\'s title bar and buttons. This needs Android 14 or newer and LX Bridge. Games still open full screen. Apps that block screenshots show black.
